candidate_pipeline.candidate_rows: track x unit opportunities plus a deduplicated verification-key table
candidate_pipeline.label_independent_selection_basis: Label-independent structural query coverage: among the three preregistered local detectors, Y8 alone has nonempty registered class support for both Q1 and Q2.
candidate_pipeline.tracker_scope: fresh tracker state per 10-second unit, matching frozen proxy semantics

cycle1_complete_only_after: positive/negative, hard-positive/hard-negative, and duplicate-event coverage audited

frozen_oracle.abstention_policy: retain as abstain; never coerce or drop
frozen_oracle.policy: one generic OBJECT_ENTERS_EGO_PATH call per selected 10-second unit

allowed: Nexar alert/event time as a weak sampling anchor
causally extracted frozen Y8 features and scores
prohibited: V0/V1 oracle/reference outcomes or configurations selected from those outcomes
V0/V1 media, slices, re-encodings, or other media derivatives as pool examples
old 5-second Nexar VLM outputs as labels or selection signals
oracle evidence free text for Q1/Q2 projection

scientific_question: Does a licensed, provider-separated pool with no exact V0/V1 overlap contain enough Q1/Q2-positive unit-level verify opportunities, including score failures, to train and discriminate an L1 refiner?

abstain_and_retry.parse_or_runtime_failure: retain the call identity and failure status; no replacement identity and no additional call without a separately authorized protocol amendment

stage_a_support_pilot.fallback: FAIL_CLOSED before any oracle call if any stratum x split cell cannot be filled; there is no quota borrowing, threshold relaxation, stratum substitution, or label-aware replacement.
stage_a_support_pilot.freeze_rule: All 96 identities and both query witnesses are durable before call 1.
stage_a_support_pilot.freeze_timing: all 96 identities frozen before first Stage-A oracle call
stage_a_support_pilot.mutual_exclusion: Once a source-video x unit is selected, it is unavailable to every later stratum.
stage_a_support_pilot.quota_algorithm: For each stratum in priority order and each split in fixed split_order, greedily take the first eligible unselected unit in the stated total order while enforcing the global two-unit provider-video cap.
stage_a_support_pilot.selection_unit: one generic physical oracle call per unique source video x unit

model_calibration.failure_action: Reject frozen-pool trainability; do not adaptively replace rows.

model_train.failure_action: Stage B may enrich model_train only if evaluation splits pass.

pool_audit.failure_action: Reject frozen-pool trainability; do not adaptively replace rows.

strata_in_priority_order.name: Q2_Y8_HIGH
strata_in_priority_order.ranking: q2_score descending, then selection_hash and identity ascending

strata_in_priority_order.eligibility: sampling_tag_only == collision_or_near_collision and absolute distance between unit anchor and provider event anchor <= 5.0 seconds
strata_in_priority_order.name: Q1_WEAK_COLLISION_NEAR_ANCHOR
strata_in_priority_order.ranking: q1_score descending, anchor_distance_seconds ascending, then selection_hash and identity ascending

strata_in_priority_order.eligibility: sampling_tag_only == collision_or_near_collision and absolute distance between unit anchor and provider event anchor <= 5.0 seconds
strata_in_priority_order.name: LOW_SCORE_WEAK_COLLISION_NEAR_ANCHOR
strata_in_priority_order.ranking: max(q1_score,q2_score) ascending, anchor_distance_seconds ascending, then selection_hash and identity ascending

strata_in_priority_order.name: HIGH_SCORE_WEAK_NORMAL
strata_in_priority_order.ranking: max(q1_score,q2_score) descending, then selection_hash and identity ascending

strata_in_priority_order.name: Q1_Q2_SCORE_DISAGREEMENT
strata_in_priority_order.ranking: abs(q1_score-q2_score) descending, then selection_hash and identity ascending

support_existence_gate.failure_action: Do not scale oracle calls on Nexar alone; acquire a directly licensed, query-enriched independent source.

stage_b_bounded_top_up.adjacent_unit_follow_up: at most two neighbors per positive unit, within total cap
stage_b_bounded_top_up.failure_action: reject Nexar-only sufficiency and add a new independent source
stage_b_bounded_top_up.hard_negative_definition: oracle negative in top frozen Y8 score quartile for query
stage_b_bounded_top_up.hard_positive_definition: oracle positive in bottom frozen Y8 score quartile for query
stage_b_bounded_top_up.multi_unit_positive_event_definition: one k3_bridge_safe event group containing at least two directly adjacent oracle-positive unit IDs within a source video and query

unit_and_label_scope.duplicate_event_rule: Frozen K3 bridge-safe grouping within source video and query: join only directly adjacent queried-positive unit IDs, never bridge a queried negative, and require the proposed core duration <= min(d_core_max=40s,d_seg_max=60s). Candidate opportunities remain separate verification keys.
unit_and_label_scope.row_rule: One supervised opportunity row per verification key. Do not copy a unit label onto all tracks. A pre-label deterministic witness or explicit multiple-instance model is required.
unit_and_label_scope.unitization: anchors at 5,15,25,... seconds; if the final nominal anchor exceeds duration, anchor at duration and use the preceding 5 seconds; the final unit may overlap the prior unit
